description: Connect a data warehouse with a read-only user. Sequenzy runs a test query before saving and returns the warehouse's reason when it fails. Next, preview a query with `preview_warehouse_query` and create a sync.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

config.description: Connection settings. snowflake: account, username, warehouse, database, schema?, role?. bigquery: projectId, location?. redshift/postgres: host, port?, database, username, sslMode? (require or verify-full).

credentials.description: Secrets, stored encrypted and never returned. snowflake: privateKey (PKCS#8 PEM), privateKeyPassphrase?. bigquery: serviceAccountJson (the key file contents). redshift/postgres: password. Ask the user for these; never invent them.

name: create_warehouse_connection

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_warehouse_connection` MCP tool.

connection.description: The warehouse connection record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
